columnConventions.ownerId: id BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
columnConventions.audit: creator VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL; create_time DATETIME(3) NOT NULL; updater VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL; update_time DATETIME(3) NOT NULL; deleted BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT b'0'
columnConventions.noBusinessDefaults: all source, relationship, dimension, status and version facts have no default unless explicitly stated

com_sales_order_contract_relation.sourceIdentity: tenantId+sourceSystem+salesOrderSourceKey+contractSourceKey; both normalized keys are stored verbatim and are never concatenated, truncated or hashed
checks: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from

com_project_contract_relation.currentUniquePolicy: generated current_marker=1 only when relation_status=ACTIVE and effective_to IS NULL; UNIQUE(tenant_id,project_id,contract_id,current_marker)
checks: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from
MATCHED requires all matched/decided fields; PENDING_RECONCILIATION requires them null
com_authority_candidate.immutability: source identity, payload and evidence are append-only; reconcile links an existing CONFIRMED owner row and never promotes or rewrites candidate payload

com_order_line.existingCanonicalField: quantity_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL; values CONFIRMED/PENDING_AUTHORITY; never rename, duplicate or dual-write authority_status
com_order_line.newCheck: source_lifecycle_status IS NULL OR source_lifecycle_status IN sourceLifecycleStatus
com_order_line.qualificationPredicate: quantity_status=CONFIRMED AND quantity>0 AND normalized unit_code nonblank AND source_lifecycle_status=ACTIVE AND source_updated_at IS NOT NULL AND at least one normalized item_code/model_code nonblank
com_order_line.legacyDisposition: no PENDING_RECONCILIATION business status is written; rows failing the predicate remain unchanged, are excluded by query, and have deterministic plt_migration_issue evidence

existingColumns.current_marker: generated TINYINT; V70 marks ACTIVE current only

preservedChecks: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from
com_delivery_scope.qualificationPredicate: scope_status IN (ACTIVE,CONFLICT) AND effective_to IS NULL AND normalized source_evidence nonblank AND parent order line satisfies its qualification predicate
com_delivery_scope.legacyDisposition: source_evidence remains nullable; null evidence is never default-filled and excludes the row with a deterministic migration issue
com_delivery_scope.generatedColumnChange: forward migration must replace current_marker expression so ACTIVE or CONFLICT with effective_to IS NULL yields 1; preflight rejects duplicate current rows before replacing uk_com_scope_current

qualifiedRowChecks: database checks are conditional: unit_code IS NULL OR all following qualified rules hold
product_code or model_code is normalized nonblank
RESOLVED requires positive site_id and null location_text
UNRESOLVED requires null site ids and nonblank location_text
com_delivery_scope_detail.serialUniquePolicy: trim + Locale.ROOT uppercase comparison key is unique per current tenant/project/order_line
com_delivery_scope_detail.qualificationPredicate: parent scope qualifies AND detail_status=ACTIVE AND normalized unit_code nonblank AND location_resolution_status is valid AND location fields satisfy the selected variant AND product/model rule holds AND serial quantity rule holds
com_delivery_scope_detail.legacyDisposition: no reconciliation status is written; any missing new dimension keeps the row unchanged, excluded by query and represented by deterministic plt_migration_issue; no defaults or text inference
com_delivery_scope_detail.sumRule: qualified current detail allocated_qty sum equals parent allocated_qty

com_delivery_scope_project_version.allocation: all COM scope mutations use orderLineId,scopeId,detailId,projectId-watermark order; lock/create the project watermark last and compare the caller expected version before writes; each current-set, returned-payload or conflict change increments exactly once, including transition to empty; deletion forbidden

com_outbox_event.rule: conflict is persisted and audited but F-COM-001 adds no public conflict event

ProjectDeliveryScopeQualificationFactApi.trustedContext: explicit tenantId equals TenantContextHolder tenantId; actorId and projectId are positive
ProjectDeliveryScopeQualificationFactApi.qualification: the actor is the current PROJECT_MANAGER and the target project is in the same actor's current ProjectScopeApi.ACTION_EDIT result
ProjectDeliveryScopeQualificationFactApi.revalidation: compare lifecycle, stage, projectVersion, participantFactVersion and treeVersion after locking root project, target project, active tree version and current authorization facts
ProjectDeliveryScopeQualificationFactApi.protectedFacts: ACTIVE, NORMAL_CLOSED and EXCEPTION_CLOSED plus current S0-S6 are comparable; S5/S6 or closed facts cause COM reduction/release to become CONFLICT

DeliveryScopeApi.getAssignedScope.trustedContext: tenantId from TenantContextHolder; explicit tenant must match; positive projectId must be visible through ProjectScopeApi.ACTION_VIEW
DeliveryScopeApi.getAssignedScope.inspect: expectedScopeVersion=null is read-only and returns the persisted project watermark, including version 0 and an empty result
DeliveryScopeApi.getAssignedScope.lockAndRevalidate: nonnull expected version locks current order/scope/detail rows in orderLineId,scopeId,detailId order, then locks the project watermark; mismatch returns SCOPE_STALE and all scope mutation paths use the same global order
lineRules: one result line is one qualified detail; dimensions are never silently aggregated
serialNumbers empty means quantity-only; otherwise serials are unique and quantity equals serial count
productCode and modelCode may individually be null but at least one is nonblank
DeliveryScopeApi.getAssignedScope.conflictPolicy: any unresolved current CONFLICT fails the whole call with SCOPE_CONFLICT; partial or empty success is forbidden
DeliveryScopeApi.getAssignedScope.versionPolicy: payload identity includes line identity, quantity, unit, product/model and normalized serial set; any payload/current-set/conflict change allocates a new persisted version

CommerceAuthorityIngestApi.ingestBatch.versionType: sourceVersion is an opaque normalized string of length 1..64; sourceWatermark is opaque normalized string of length 1..128; lexical or numeric ordering is forbidden
CommerceAuthorityIngestApi.ingestBatch.atomicity: one tenant/source batch is all-or-nothing; no per-item partial success
versionDecisionOrder: for contract, sales order and order line lock current object by tenant/sourceSystem/sourceKey
for order-contract relation lock current object by tenant/sourceSystem/salesOrderSourceKey/contractSourceKey
if absent: expectedPreviousSourceVersion must be null, then create
if incoming sourceVersion equals current sourceVersion: compare the frozen canonical owner payload before predecessor CAS; equal is OBJECT_REPLAY and different is SOURCE_VERSION_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT
if incoming sourceVersion differs: expectedPreviousSourceVersion must exactly equal current sourceVersion, then update; otherwise SOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT
CommerceAuthorityIngestApi.ingestBatch.idempotency: eventId decision precedes object decisions: same eventId and canonical full batch payload returns EVENT_REPLAYED; same eventId different payload is EVENT_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT. OBJECT_REPLAY never requires expectedPreviousSourceVersion to equal current and never enters predecessor CAS
CommerceAuthorityIngestApi.ingestBatch.batchResult: all objects OBJECT_REPLAY => ACCEPTED_NO_CHANGE; any create/update with zero conflicts => ACCEPTED even when other objects replay; any object/event conflict rolls back every owner/relation write and no scopeVersion/outbox is produced
CommerceAuthorityIngestApi.ingestBatch.replaySideEffects: a new eventId may complete its batch idempotency/audit record, but OBJECT_REPLAY does not rewrite owner payload/version, allocate scopeVersion or publish business Outbox
CommerceAuthorityIngestApi.ingestBatch.failure: any validation, mapping or write failure rolls back; retry same eventId; no empty-success degradation
CommerceAuthorityIngestApi.ingestBatch.connectorBoundary: network auth, polling, transport retry and external reconciliation remain INT-01

authorization.projectScopeWrites: functional permission + ProjectDeliveryScopeQualificationFactApi current PROJECT_MANAGER and ACTION_EDIT composite fact for the trusted actor
authorization.contractAdministration: functional permission + OrganizationScopeApi current active scope whose companyCode equals owner companyCode; unassociated contracts outside those scopes are invisible

deliveryScopeCommandAudit.privacy: serialCount only; full serial lists, attachments and ERP source payload are forbidden
deliveryScopeCommandAudit.atomicity: the detail snapshot, scope history, project watermark, platform idempotency completion and outbox commit or roll back together

migration.batchRule: preserve every source row/payload, map only qualified rows, record each rejected reason, and reconcile counts/status by batch

sms_ofst_contract_head_sap.qualification: preserve raw row only: no company code, lifecycle status or monotonic source version is present, and dataSource is CRM; it cannot create com_contract without separately approved row-level evidence, so current rows become issues

pm_order_data_from_erp.valueMapping: source+compCode+orderType+orderNumber is the candidate business key; orderType 1 is RETURNED, orderType 0 still lacks a proven lifecycle/version contract and remains pending; contractNo only proposes a relation
pm_order_data_from_erp.qualification: missing stable sourceVersion, lifecycle evidence or resolvable parent contract prevents CONFIRMED owner creation

pm_order_line_from_erp.qualification: parent and stable line resolve; positive orderQuantity; missing unit/model/lifecycle stays pending

pm_project_product_line.qualification: project, orderLine and positive projectQuantity resolve; audited projectQuantity is empty, and other quantities never substitute, so those rows remain issues

migration.invalidRows: preserve source row; create deterministic issue; create no owner/current-scope fact

migrationEvidenceContract.transactionRule: claimStagedBatch requires a caller-owned transaction; claim, COM target writes, PLT result appends and completeReconciliation join that transaction so failure restores STAGED_READY
migrationEvidenceContract.sourceBatchIdentityRule: append source requires command tenant/sourceSystem/sourceTable to equal the locked batch; reconciliation results lock and accept only the frozen source selected by trusted tenantId+batchId+sourceRecordId
migrationEvidenceContract.reconciliationVersionRule: claim returns the authoritative RECONCILING batch version; result/issue appends do not update batch.version or final counts; complete uses the claim version, recomputes classifications and performs one CAS

importTerminalUnion.READY: requires manifest row count/schema/hash, forbids failureCode and enters STAGED_READY after validation
importTerminalUnion.FAIL_IMPORT: forbids successful manifest facts, requires a closed importFailureCode and enters FAILED
importTerminalUnion.transientProviderFailure: does not enter FAILED and retries the same intent

appendExternalMappingUnion.MAPPED: one or more stable target mappings are required
appendExternalMappingUnion.RETAINED: target mappings must be empty and the source row is classified as retained

migrationEvidenceContract.completionInvariant: each frozen source has exactly one final result and sourceCount = mappedCount + issueCount + retainedCount before COMPLETED
migrationEvidenceContract.countUnit: mappedCount, issueCount and retainedCount count unique source records, not target mapping rows or issue rows
migrationEvidenceContract.issueClosure: only an OPEN issue in a COMPLETED batch may be closed once; append resolver, ruleVersion and targetResult without reopening or recounting the batch

checks: only COMPLETED stores final classification counts and rule version

plt_external_key_mapping.union: MAPPED requires complete target fields; RETAINED requires every target field null
plt_external_key_mapping.uniqueResult: generated result_key is RETAINED or targetRole:targetSequence; unique per tenant/source

plt_migration_issue.closure: OPEN has all resolution fields null; CLOSED has resolver, ruleVersion, targetResult and resolvedAt; version CAS
